page.layout: One column of running text with two margin notes at the right. Below a rule: a centred chapter heading with title, then the Exodus passage in italic verses. At the foot, one block of small-type notes, with a catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: pacem spondeas, cum bellum pares secreto, fraudulenter facis; præsertim si aperte sermone, certam pacem præ te feras. Quo prudentius Senatus noster venerandus fecerat, qui, licet Hispano pacem offerenti specie tenus[?], {h}aurem In colloq. cum Parmen- si Duc. An- no 1588. accommodaret, non credidit tamen nimium fraudulento consilio. Ille tamen satis turpiter, qui tunc omni vi, An-gliam invadere destinauerat. Sed de istis satis. Ita menda-cia in nullo hominum excusanda censemus; non officiosa; non iocosa; non perniciosa; non in Medico; non in Theo-logo; non in Rebecca; non in Rahab; non in obstetrici-bus; nedum in {i}Anania & Saphyra, qui Spiritui Sancto Act. 5. v. 3. mentiti, tremendas luerunt fui sceleris poenas: sed loquendam veritatem, omnibus, & ubique, nec pro æterna alterius salute, malis utendum mediis: quia sic voluit veritatis Deus, cui cum filio, & spiritu, sit gloria in æternum.
main_text.head: CAPUT SECUNDUM. DE CIRCUMCISIONE per Tsipporam.

p.i: Exod. 4. 24. Euenit autem in illo itinere, in diversorio quodam, ut occurreret Mosi Jehoua, velut quærens morte afficere eum.
25. Sed accipiens Tsippora cultrum acutum, amputauit præputium filij sui, & admouit pedibus illius; nam inquit illa, sponsus sanguinum es mihi.
26. Sic destitit Jehouah ab illo: dixerat autem tunc sponsum sanguinum, propter circumcisionem.

main_text.p: 1. Infantulum circumcidit fœmina. 3. Circumcisionem excipit Baptismus apud Christianos. 4. Num ad salutem absolute

page.notes: Running head and page number read from a small, old-style figure; "59" is a best reading. "specie tenus" is doubtful (tenus[?]). The margin note "In colloq. cum Parmen- si Duc. An- no 1588." is partly unclear, especially "si Duc. An-". Note mark "h" in the text is small and partly merged with "aurem"; placed before "aurem". A small mark below the text centre (around the foot of the page) is not clearly printed text and is not transcribed. Only the first verse number "1" in the small-type block is read as printed; the following "2" is absent. The catchword is "sit ne-" at the right.
